# PR315 R2 closes the complete-caller cost guard

At 7d79009c5a1ad190f9c34ec717c32d37e2653511, R315-P1/R315-F001 is closed:
both reaper roster reads use live_only. Its fresh after-count has unchanged
meaning; main always discarded tombstoned rows before counting too.

The ListSpy test over the real store records [true,true,true] across dry
and non-dry runs and checks their live counts. L4, restoring the final
generic query, fails with [true,true,false]. Together with the store's
runtime indexed-query refusal test, it guards the complete caller rather
than only an exported SQL constant.

Same 3279-row/212-live copy, independent paired CPU medians:
main12.759ms, R1 6.789ms, R2 0.709ms; observer0.852->0.360ms.
Two roster lists materialize424 live descriptors per non-dry sweep,
not6558 historical ones; per-live-seat checks remain separately priced.
Raw/reproducer: Copilot session43dfc7b1-1b7e-463d-af0d-4f4aae11d8bf,
files/pr315-r2-query-cost.json and pr315-r2-query-cost.py.
Committed tombstone/revive timings dominated by commit are not a proof of
zero index maintenance; retain R1's live-upsert delete/reinsert clarification.

The D1 baseline on PID16325/build8b437897e3 still stands for post-deploy
AFTER: SQLite4.366784 CPU seconds per60.009666s on November21,2026.
Do not use the older pre-D1 daemon as an exclusive PR315 comparator.
AFTER remains owed; final-round verdict has no remaining blocker.
